clue.text: Volume of food bagged by man social worker has shot in back

indicators.note: something bagged is held inside a sack, so the chess man here wraps round the rest

parts.note: a chessman; it is split R...OOK round the rest

indicators.note: going back means this combined piece is read from right to left
the social insect has the photograph placed inside it

parts.note: the bee is the crossword's usual social worker, a hive insect
a pic is a photo, a shot

explanation.surface: A chef is bagged for a social worker's shooting, picturing a crime in a kitchen.
explanation.walkthrough: The chessman is the rook, cut after its first letter to hold the rest. 'Volume' is a book, not loudness.
explanation.definitionFit: A cookbook is a volume, a book, of instructions for making food dishes.

clue.text: Lunch? Departmental head misses starter …

indicators.note: missing the starter means the opening letter is left off

parts.note: a prefect is the head of a French department

explanation.surface: A head of department skips the first course at lunch.
explanation.walkthrough: A French département is run by a préfet, a prefect. The question mark flags that lunch is a verb here and just one example.
explanation.definitionFit: To refect is an old verb meaning to refresh with food and drink, which is what lunching does.

clue.text: … a snack at reception might do

parts.note: can, like might, expresses possibility
to do someone is to imitate them

explanation.surface: Following the previous clue: a snack at a party might do instead of lunch.
explanation.definitionFit: A canapé is a small bite-sized savoury served at drinks receptions.

clue.text: Thwarting set in advance is trademark Trump

indicators.note: to thwart is literally to lie across, so this word spans the other inside it

parts.note: preselect means choose in advance; split PRES...ELECT
an ident is a broadcaster's brand logo sequence

explanation.surface: Obstruction planned ahead is typical Trump.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Trump' looks like a verb; it is the man, who was waiting to take office when this appeared in January 2025.
explanation.definitionFit: Trump was the president-elect, the winner of the election not yet inaugurated, at the time of publication.

clue.text: I'm scared to open device that signals apiculturist

indicators.note: an opening is made in the device and the exclamation goes inside it

parts.note: a beeper or pager; split B...EEPER
eek is a cry of fright

explanation.surface: Someone frightened to open a device that sends signals.
explanation.walkthrough: 'that signals' is a link phrase: the wordplay signals the definition.
explanation.definitionFit: Apiculture is the keeping of bees, so an apiculturist is someone who tends hives.

clue.text: Symbol of some resistance, nothing very big

parts.note: O is zero, nothing
mega is slang for huge

explanation.surface: A small token of resistance amounts to nothing much.
explanation.walkthrough: Resistance is electrical, measured in ohms, whose symbol is capital Greek omega.
explanation.definitionFit: Capital omega is the symbol for the ohm, the unit of electrical resistance.

clue.text: Book Max S's famous opponent?

definitions.meaning: first meaning: a prophetic book of the Old Testament
second meaning: Max Schmeling's great rival Joe Louis, cut short as Max S is, to a first name and initial

explanation.walkthrough: Max Schmeling fought the boxer Joe Louis twice; shortening his surname as the clue shortens Schmeling gives JOE L, hence the question mark.
explanation.definitionFit: Joel is one of the Minor Prophets, whose book sits in the Old Testament of the Bible.

clue.text: Material long suppressed by newspaper?

indicators.note: in a down clue, being held down beneath something puts it lower in the column

parts.note: an organ is a newspaper or journal that speaks for a group
to die for something is to long for it

explanation.surface: Fabric that a newspaper has long been keeping quiet about.
explanation.definitionFit: Organdie is a fine, stiff, translucent cotton fabric used for dresses.

clue.text: Learner blocks weird cousin making an entrance exam

indicators.note: making an entrance means coming in, so the cousin enters the other pieces

parts.note: L for learner, as on L-plates
Cousin Itt is the hairy relative in The Addams Family
Lego is a brand of toy building blocks

explanation.surface: A learner driver obstructs an odd relative who is making a grand entrance to an exam.
explanation.walkthrough: 'entrance exam' looks like the definition, but 'entrance' belongs with the insertion, and the little-go was not an entrance test. The cousin is the hairy one from The Addams Family.
explanation.definitionFit: The little-go was the old nickname for the first preliminary examination for a Cambridge degree.

clue.text: Professional who must have faith in Nick

definitions.text: Professional who must have faith in Nick

parts.words: Professional who must have faith in Nick
parts.note: surface reading: someone whose job requires trusting a colleague named Nick
setter's reading: religious faith, exercised inside the nick, British slang for a jail

explanation.walkthrough: Nick is British slang for prison, and the faith is religious belief, so this is a clergyman working in a jail.
explanation.definitionFit: A cleric attached to a jail is a professional minister who brings religion to inmates.

clue.text: Injury from dropping shield

indicators.note: dropping something lets it fall away, so those letters leave the longer word

parts.note: offence in its old sense of harm or hurt
of can mean from, as in 'a man of Kent'

explanation.surface: Someone hurt after letting their shield fall in battle.
explanation.walkthrough: The surface reads 'dropping shield' together, but 'from' is the word dropped and 'shield' alone is the definition.
explanation.definitionFit: A fence is a barrier that guards or screens, so as a verb or noun it serves as a protective shield.

clue.text: Emperor's first rather direct order

indicators.note: the first of the word means only its opening letter is kept

parts.note: the opening letter of Emperor
'Rather!' is an old British exclamation of hearty agreement
right as in straight, direct

explanation.surface: The Emperor issues a forthright command to his subjects.
explanation.definitionFit: Eyes right is a parade-ground command for troops to turn their heads, so it is a military order.

clue.text: Turnover figure recorded for The Crown?

definitions.meaning: first meaning: to overturn, as a boat does
second meaning, read as two words: the head measurement taken for a hat, a crown being the top of the head

explanation.walkthrough: 'Turnover' and 'The Crown' suggest business and the monarchy; split as CAP SIZE the answer is a hatter's measurement for a crown.
explanation.definitionFit: To capsize is to overturn, a turnover in the literal sense of a boat flipping in the water.

clue.text: Big club result: fix is denied

indicators.note: read as I's denied: the letter standing for one is refused a place in both words

parts.note: to arise is to result, to follow from
to nail is to fix in place

explanation.surface: A big football club's result is rumoured to have been fixed, which they deny.
explanation.walkthrough: 'is' is read as I's, the letter I in the plural, and both I's go. Arsenal is a north London football club.
explanation.definitionFit: Arsenal is one of England's biggest football clubs, so it is a big club.

clue.text: Petition stays refined and puts in request for a rise

indicators.note: refined ore is worked over and reshaped, so the letters that follow are reworked
stays is read as supports or holds, so the petition word holds the rest within it

parts.note: to beg is to petition; it is split BE...G
these nine letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: A petition, once refined, is submitted asking for a pay rise.
explanation.walkthrough: 'request for a rise' looks like a pay claim; it is the formal call to stand, as for a judge or a toast.
explanation.definitionFit: 'Be upstanding' is the formal command asking everyone to stand up, a request that they rise.

clue.text: Alien after Romulus, perhaps no longer after Flash

indicators.note: what is no longer after has been taken from the end, so the final letters fall away

parts.note: Romulus was a twin, brother of Remus
Klingons are aliens in Star Trek

explanation.surface: An alien chases a Romulan, maybe no longer pursuing the Flash, a mash of science-fiction names.
explanation.walkthrough: The alien comes after TWIN, then loses its last two letters, the ON hiding in 'no longer'.
explanation.definitionFit: In a twinkling means in an instant, so the word is a noun for a flash of time.

clue.text: Twister entitled man to reach round gentleman's bottom

indicators.note: reaching round something means encircling it

parts.note: a squire is a country gentleman
Mr is the title given to a man
points to the last letter of the gentleman word, the one the title goes round

explanation.surface: A dancer with a title reaches round a gentleman's backside.
explanation.walkthrough: The title goes round only the bottom letter of the gentleman word, not the whole of it, which is what makes this hard to see.
explanation.definitionFit: A squirmer twists and wriggles, so it is something that writhes like a twister.

clue.text: New kids on the block expected a beautiful woman

parts.note: par is the expected score, as in golf
Venus, the goddess of love, stands for any beautiful woman

explanation.surface: Recent arrivals in the neighbourhood were expecting a beauty.
explanation.walkthrough: 'New Kids on the Block' recalls the boy band; here it means newcomers.
explanation.definitionFit: Parvenus are upstarts newly risen in society, newcomers not yet accepted there.

clue.text: Window only 75% of the specified weight?

definitions.meaning: first meaning: a small pivoting window in a car door
second meaning, whimsically: a quarter short of the weight

explanation.walkthrough: Something light by a quarter weighs only three quarters of what it should, hence the question mark.
explanation.definitionFit: A quarter light is the small triangular side window in older cars, separate from the main door glass.

clue.text: Having heading removed in question paper

indicators.note: removing the heading cuts off the very first letter

parts.note: at issue means under discussion, in question

explanation.surface: An exam paper with its heading cut off is called into question.
explanation.definitionFit: Tissue is a soft thin paper, as in tissue paper or a paper handkerchief.

clue.text: A spirit intolerant of OAPs

parts.note: taken as written
Geist is German for spirit, as in zeitgeist

explanation.surface: A ghost that cannot stand pensioners.
explanation.walkthrough: OAP is British for old-age pensioner.
explanation.definitionFit: Ageist describes discrimination against people because of their age, such as the elderly.

clue.text: Patient beginning to vomit through wearing a cap

indicators.note: going through something puts it inside, so the letter passes into the phrase

parts.note: in a lid, a lid being a cap; it is split IN...ALID

indicators.note: the beginning of a word is its first letter alone

parts.note: the opening letter of vomit

explanation.surface: A capped patient begins to be sick.
explanation.walkthrough: Lid is slang for a hat, so 'wearing a cap' is IN A LID.
explanation.definitionFit: An invalid is a sick person under care, which is what a patient is.

clue.text: Admitting case for endoscopist, treat by cleansing

indicators.note: admitting someone lets them in, so the verb takes the outer letters inside

parts.note: to do is to treat, as in do someone a favour; split D...O

indicators.note: a case is the outside of something, so only the outer letters are used

parts.note: the first and last letters of endoscopist
x is the multiplication sign, read as by, as in three by four

explanation.surface: A doctor's endoscope case is cleaned as part of hygiene treatment.
explanation.definitionFit: A detox is a cleanse, a period of ridding the body of toxins.

clue.text: He wrote casually off with line on top of second page

indicators.note: placed on top of something, one letter covers and takes the place of another

parts.note: kipping is slang for sleeping, being off in the sense of asleep
the usual abbreviation for line
the second letter P in the slang word, P being page

explanation.surface: A writer dashes something off and puts a line at the top of the second page.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Casually' marks the slang: to kip is British for to sleep. The second of its two P's becomes L.
explanation.definitionFit: Rudyard Kipling was an author, of The Jungle Book among others, so he is a man who wrote.

clue.text: Crazed ego fed with too much Italian food

indicators.note: something fed with food has it put inside, so the short excess term goes in

parts.note: manic means wild, crazed
OTT is short for over the top
the ego is the self, I

explanation.surface: An egomaniac stuffs themselves with too much Italian cooking.
explanation.walkthrough: The ego, I, follows the crazed word, and the excess goes in between the two.
explanation.definitionFit: Manicotti are large stuffed pasta tubes baked in sauce, a dish from Italy.

clue.text: Very musical, Ireland's overture — when it begins

indicators.note: begins puts the words before it at the front of the answer

parts.note: as in 'as I arrived'
it and SA both mean sex appeal

indicators.note: an overture opens a work, so only the opening letter of the country is kept

parts.note: the opening letter of Ireland

explanation.surface: Ireland's national overture is played, and it is very musical when it starts.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Very musical' means 'very' in musical language, as in allegro assai.
explanation.definitionFit: Assai is the Italian tempo direction meaning very, as in allegro assai for very fast.

clue.text: People other than me sleep on street

parts.note: re means on the subject of
the usual abbreviation for street

explanation.surface: Others but not me end up sleeping rough on the street.
explanation.walkthrough: Two meanings, others and sleep, both built from the same wordplay.
explanation.definitionFit: 'The rest' is everyone else besides me, and rest is also repose or sleep.

clue.text: What's recognised by IO2U note in gym?

definitions.text: What's recognised by IO2U note in gym?

parts.words: What's recognised by IO2U note in gym?
parts.note: surface reading: a strange code scribbled on a note left at the gym
setter's reading: an IOU note, I owe you, for O2, the gas we breathe; owing that after hard exercise

explanation.walkthrough: IOU means I owe you; slipping in O2, the chemical formula for the gas, makes it I owe you some of that gas, a debt incurred by hard exercise.
explanation.definitionFit: After strenuous exercise muscles run short of the gas and must repay the shortfall with heavy breathing, a physiological debt.
